questions.prompt: Code review: one line breaks our naming convention. Click it.
questions.explanation: Class names are kebab-case: `.post-header`. The same goes for ids, SCSS variables and mixins (`$card-radius`, `@mixin flex-center`).

questions.prompt: Code review: one color is not in our format. Click the line.
questions.explanation: All colors use the same format: lowercase hex, as XD gives them. `rgb(142, 142, 142)` is `#8e8e8e`. One format makes colors easy to search for and compare. For transparency use 8-digit hex, for example `#00000080`.

questions.prompt: Code review: one line uses a unit we only allow in one place. Click it.
questions.explanation: `vh` and `vw` are used once, in the top-level app container. A component that measures the window ignores the layout around it (top bar, side panel), so it breaks when it is placed somewhere else. Inside components use `%` for sizes that follow the parent and `px` for fixed values from the design.

questions.prompt: Code review: one selector breaks our conventions. Click it.
questions.explanation: We style classes, not tags. `img` matches every image in the card, including the avatar, so adding an image later changes it by surprise. Give the element a class (`.post-image`) and style that.

questions.prompt: Code review: one rule is in the wrong place. Click the line where it starts.
questions.explanation: All component styles go inside `:host { }`. Only things that are not rules, like `@use`, variables and mixin definitions, sit above it.

questions.prompt: You are styling the post card component from the XD design. Which declarations follow our unit rules? Select all that apply.

options.text: `width: 614px;` (the width of the card on the XD artboard)

questions.explanation: Sizes that should follow the parent use `%`, so the card fits any screen. Fixed values from the design (spacing, borders, font sizes, icon sizes) use `px`. A fixed card width copied from the artboard only fits that one screen, and `vh`/`vw` belong only in the top-level app container.

questions.prompt: Which names follow our naming convention? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Everything is kebab-case: lowercase words joined with `-`. No camelCase, no underscores, and no BEM `__` or `--`.
